title: Your Google Account Still Trusts Old Apps? Check This #Shorts
description: A visual, original fictional learning example from FlowMinute Lab. That old app you stopped using might still be connected to your Google Account. Review access rather than guessing. Learn the safe verification step using the official product guidance below. Original diagrams and synthetic English narration; not a real account or software screen capture. Official source: https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/13533235 #FlowMinuteLab #TechTips

scenes.title: OLD APP ACCESS
scenes.narration: That old app you stopped using might still be connected to your Google Account. Review access rather than guessing.

scenes.title: WHAT ACCESS?
scenes.narration: Third-party connections can be used for Sign in with Google or to access permitted account data, depending on your grant.

scenes.title: OPEN THE LIST
scenes.narration: From your Google Account's security and connections area, review third-party apps and services with access.

scenes.title: REMOVE IF UNUSED
scenes.narration: If an app no longer needs access, remove its connection. Google documents that access can be revoked.

scenes.title: DO NOT OVERCLAIM
scenes.narration: Removing access stops future access through that grant; it may not erase data already shared with the service.
